name: 33566 · Plant City, FL
findings: ZIP 33566 (Plant City) has 49 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (54% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33566 (Plant City) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33566 (Plant City) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 18% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.
